$comment: License policy for the full transitive dependency tree. Enforced by scripts/license-gate.mjs.
The gate FAILS CLOSED: anything not positively matched by 'allow' stops the build.
Every dependency must be compatible with permissive redistribution AND with
operating the code as a network service. That second clause is why AGPL is fatal here and why
a component we merely *operate* (search engine, indexer, database) counts as a dependency.
$acknowledgedComment: Human-reviewed exceptions. Only 'review'-class licenses may be acknowledged here — a 'block'
license can NEVER be acknowledged, and the gate enforces that. Every entry needs a reason and
$prefixReviewComment: Any license family matched by these prefixes but not listed explicitly above lands in 'review'
rather than being treated as unknown. Keeps the gate honest about versioned SPDX ids without
$blockPrefixComment: Prefix families that are always fatal. Checked AFTER reviewPrefixes so that LGPL- is not
swallowed by GPL-. Order matters and the gate asserts it.
